habitat: Sunny open ground, fields and roadsides
season: Spring through fall; year-round in the far south
identification: Brown upper wings with large eyespots and orange bars.
fact: Its large eyespots may startle predators.
form: Representative form; individual colors and markings vary

source.title: Butterflies and Moths of North America
